items.title: FW14 R&D: compare HEN 13.52/14.00 sources, GoldHEN releases, encrypted PUP blocks
items.summary: ## Technical research - Pin Scene-Collective PS4-HEN commit `d077fb4`, compare FW 13.52 and FW14 designated initializer offsets, verify `MAX_FW=1400` and the actual `case 1400` dispatch. Preserve field-by-field JSON audit, sentinel checks. - Audit **official** GoldHEN releases metadata separately from PS4-HEN open-source support: GoldHEN's upstream repository does not contain full 2.4b18.x source, and HEN FW14 tables do not supply a kernel exploit. - Compare Sony 13.52/14.00 verified encrypted PUP entries using 16 KiB ciphertext SHA-256 block maps, counting identity at the same position or any position. **NO decryption, no dump of proprietary kernel, no redistribution of firmware, no payloads**. - Explain exact blocker and why forcing 13.52 kernel patch offsets onto FW14 is unsafe. ## Tests HEN source/release CI: https://github.com/DanieleDellUomo/ps4-exploit-launcher/actions/runs/392914
items.author: DanieleDellUomo

items.title: R&D FW14: inspect public GoldHEN and PS4-HEN payloads and document PUP block diff
items.summary: Measured **actual public binary payloads** without running them: Raw13G-hosted `goldhen.bin` (293,120 B, sha256 df3f27c1...) and Scene-Collective `hen.bin` prerelease-182 (500,448 B, sha256 c05f6097...). Records sizes, SHA-256, header signatures and selected version strings, without sharing payloads or inferring FW14 jailbreak. Documents two distinct projects and limitations of static metadata. Adds actual Sony PUP 13.52 vs 14.00 encrypted 16 KiB block counts: entry1 545/19900 equal, entry2 20/10821 equal; no claim that these are kernel instruction patch rates. **CI verified:** https://github.com/DanieleDellUomo/ps4-exploit-launcher/actions/runs/39292331439 **PUP count verified:** https://github.com/DanieleDellUomo/ps4-exploit-launcher/actions/runs/39292062992

items.title: Research FW14 Slopkit JSScope regression with one-shot PS4 browser test
items.summary: ## Risultato della ricerca Fonti PS4 Dev Wiki indicano che la **primitiva JSScope di Slopkit** non restituisce più l'oggetto interno a partire dal firmware **14.00** (verifica attribuita a ufm42, 20 settembre 2026). Questo contraddice l'ipotesi, presente in alcuni repository sperimentali, che gli entry point WebKit precedenti siano sicuramente ancora validi. ## Implementazione - `webkit-regression.html`: pagina PS4 a esecuzione manuale, con gate firmware 14.00. - `webkit-regression.js`: riproduce **solo una chiamata** alla piccola funzione `leakScopeObject` da Raw13G; verifica il tipo del risultato, **senza** l'ulteriore manipolazione dell'oggetto, heap spray, primitive R/W, syscall o payload. - `tests/test-webkit-regression.js`: 11 verifiche di comportamento e di sicurezza su V8. - `docs/FW14_SLOPKIT_JSSCOPE_FINDINGS.md`: evidenze, fonti e limiti. - `index.html`: link alla nuova pagina.

items.title: Research: compare PS4 13.52 and 14.00 PUP outer metadata
items.summary: ## Scope The uploaded PUPs are large and the current ChatGPT container could not read them; this PR adds a repeatable **read-only** comparator for local files. Also adds a GitHub Actions workflow that attempts to download matching official Sony packages and publish **JSON metadata only**. - SLB2 outer entry parser, SHA-256 of nested *encrypted* segments, whole-file MD5/SHA256 and exact sizes - Cross-check MD5 against the publicly documented firmware hashes - Three offline synthetic-container unit tests (all pass in GitHub Actions on the research branch) - Docs outlining that no kernel diff/decryption or Relapse patch confirmation can follow from encrypted-container metadata alone No Sony firmware binaries or exploit payloads are committed. This is not an FW 14.00 jailbreak.
items.author: DanieleDellUomo

items.title: Add safe runtime tests and PS4 13.52→14.00 firmware research
items.summary: Aggiunge una pagina di test funzionali **non invasivi** per il browser PS4 Slim 14.00 (TypedArray/DataView, Promise, Fetch stesso host, Worker, eccezioni), asset locali di prova e script di controllo PUP per PC. Documenta la differenza fra Relapse/AIO Multi Cancel pubblico su FW 13.52 e supporto HEN 14.00 senza kernel exploit pubblico. I PUP non sono inclusi e non sono stati scaricati nell'ambiente di analisi. Verifica offline dei controlli puri JS, nessuna prova ancora su console per questi nuovi test. Nessun payload, exploit, scansione memoria o telemetria. Il collegamento ai test è su diagnostics.html.

items.title: Research: identify FW14 kernel exploit blockers before active testing
items.summary: ## Obiettivo Preparare una ricerca riproducibile sulle routine AIO, senza lanciare exploit 13.52 non compatibili sulla PS4 Slim 14.00. ## Risultati - Documentazione **go/no-go** basata sul codice di Raw13G, sulle tabelle HEN 14.00 e sull'audit del prototipo `ps4-suid-scanner` (che lascia l'exploit userland non implementato). - Nuovo `tools/compare_aio_disassembly.py`: confronta le disassemblazioni di `aio_multi_wait`, `aio_multi_cancel`, ecc. *solo quando avremo i binari kernel decifrati e correttamente identificati*. - Test sintetici e GitHub Actions, nessuna modifica alla console. ## Limitazioni dichiarate I pacchetti PUP non permettono da soli di confermare la patch di Relapse. Nessun exploit kernel 14.00 è stato costruito, caricato o eseguito; nessun test pericoloso è avviato.

items.summary: ## Follow-up to #96308 — Additional regression symptom ### Symptom 15: Model loses memory of file paths and repository context within the same conversation Since ~Sep 16, 2026, Claude no longer remembers basic context like file paths and repository locations that were established earlier in the same conversation. ### Example 1: Forgets repo paths When generating git commands for the user's own repositories, the model outputs generic placeholder paths like `~/ruta/ps4-suid-scanner` instead of the actual paths it previously knew. Before the regression, Claude remembered working directory paths throughout the conversation without the user having to repeat them. ### Example 2: Fails to check user's own repos before claiming something doesn't exist User asked about PS4 firmware 14.00 offsets.
